reviews.text: We took our 14 year old dog Mathers in because he was not doing well; not eating, listless and just sleeping all the time. We actually thought it might be time to have him put down. Dr. Tomasini ran some tests and found some irregularities with his liver. We all agreed to try some new medication and give it a week to see how it works. Today he is more alert and eating. The entire staff was very helpful knowing what might have to take place.
We love the staff at Ark Pet Hospital, although I think our dog Jake has second thoughts sometimes!! They are very caring and have taken care of of our dog since he was a puppy.
Best vet close to home. Always helps me when I take my furry baby in.

We've been going here for years. Dr. Hubenak and his staff are the best! They have taken care of our dogs health, clearly communicate options for preventative meds or treatment plans, and care about their customers. Feels like a small hometown vet. Gig'em!

The Ark Pet Hospital is the best veterinary location in San Antonio.  They truly treat your pets with care as if they were their own.  They are compassionate and really offer the best care for your furry loved ones.  Highly recommend and wouldn't go anywhere else.
Great vet! Very caring about my fur babies and my wallet. Would recommend!  Staff is amazing too. Really love Animals.

this is the best vet we’ve used for my dachshund. the staff is always so friendly & gentle with my baby. i’ve boarded my dog here a couple of times with zero concerns while i went on work trips. i’m extremely particular when it comes to pet sitters but i trust them 100% with him. it takes so much stress off of me. he also had a dental cleaning with them & everything went perfectly. they are very reasonably priced too! thank you for taking such good care of my Boudin🌭
Everybody at the hospital was awesome for my little dude‘s surgery. They are all very professional and very polite and you can see they love animals. Couldn’t be more pleased.
Great experience every time I take my pet in.  Very friendly atmosphere and the Veterinarian and his staff seem to be genuinely concerned about pet.
Outstanding professional staff who truly care about our pets.  Very competent!

I love everything about The Ark Pet Hospital! Doc is amazing and his staff is equally as wonderful!  I highly recommend them to anyone who is needing veterinarian care!  Your pet will receive excellent care from a very compassionate team! Thank you for taking such great care of Cher
Otis
The staff is always very friendly and helpful, and Coco and I are well taken care of!
Been going here for 10 plus years and always happy with the service my family dogs get. Really great customer service.

Dr. Hubenak and his staff are outstanding. He was very gentle with my American Staffordshire Terrier, Jax. Very friendly and courteous team at the Ark. I highly recommend this veterinarian and his team!  CJ. Megna.
My Baby received a beak and nail trim. 🦜She was treated well and Dr. Hubenak did a great job 👍 The receptionist is friendly and makes everyone feel welcome. 🙂
The Ark Pet Hospital is the best. They treat my dogs and my parrot.

Our LuLu recently had to have surgery. Everyone in the office is patient, kind and compassionate. It is obvious that they are very caring towards fur babies!  Dr. Hubenak is kind and takes the time to explain procedures and answer questions. I cannot say enough nice words about the front staff and the vet techs at this practice, too. They are all way beyond 5 stars here!
They always take the best care of my fur babies and truly love them.

I am so impressed with the Ark Pet Hospital on Blanco Rd.  Everyone is polite, upbeat and professional.  My pet always behaves in a happy nature when I take her there which for me is proof that this is a place where animals feel safe.  I recommend Ark Pet Hospital for everyone seeking veterinary services for their pet(s).
The entire team is amazing…Erin, Ryan and Dr Zeben were juts exceptional yesterday and deserve acknowledgment.

The staff and doctor are awesome. I have a wiener dog named Tank they all know well. I feel he is in the best of care there. They take care of all my wieners! I have3 dachshunds.  I love the wiener jokes. Tanks a lot Ark!!!
Dr. Humenak was incredible! I never would have thought that I would have needed to bring an axolotl to a vet, but his fund of knowledge was amazing, and the entire staff were helpful and pleasant.

If you want an outstanding Dr for your pet and awesome compassionate people that absolutely love and care about your baby then this is the place for you! My tucker has seizures and these guys will even call me to check on him! They are absolutely amazing people and I won't go anywhere else!

The Ark Pet Hospital is Wonderful. Everyone there is truly caring in the care of my Sammy. They even called after my last appointment to be certain that he was doing well. Even though I have moved from the area, I plan to stay with The Ark for Sammy's care.
This is what quality veterinary care looks like! Dr. Hubenak and the entire Ark Team are incredible; professional and caring.
The staff friendly and professional. They provide great service and always make our boys feel comfortable.
Dr. Hubenak is an excellent vet and the staff is great  too!  I bring my bunny here and always happy with care he receives.

Absolutely thrilled with our first experience at The Ark, I brought in my two older gentlemen pups to have canine dental cleanings and they were treated with such care. Everyone was so kind and professional. The doctor himself was impressive as well and spent plenty of time after the procedure talking with me and answering questions. Fairly priced and conveniently located to the Stone Oak area.. Highly recommend this practice!
We love the Ark and our dogs do too! Can’t say enough good things about the doctor and all staff.
Dr. Hubenak and all the staff at The Ark Pet Hospital are amazing.  They take great care of my animals and offer such a nice easy going environment. I would highly recommend them!!

I have many examples of Dr H’s compassion. My first experience was when he was Dr Eldridges protégée. He worked with Dr Eldridge to help save my dog Joey. Then Dr Eldridge retired and he took over his care. He bought him a few more years and held me while I eventually had to say goodbye. He also saved our swan when he was drowning after getting his head stuck between rocks in our pond. He jumped in fully clothed and resuscitated him. My hero!
Very friendly. Very kind people

I have been taking my Dalmatian “Rooster” to the Ark since just after I got him. They have been awesome! I love the staff! He recently had his big boy surgery and did really well. I’m very happy with their care. Would highly recommend them!

The Ark treated my mutt as if she was a Westminster Winner!  It was her first time at The Ark, but they were very caring, efficient, and Dr Hubinek was most caring and professional. We will continue to use The Ark for all our pet needs.
Great service,  very upfront and caring and they always have a beautiful vibe.
Lovely experience as always!
Wonderful people and amazing service!
I encounter friendliness and great customer service each time I am there to bring in the little ones or even to pick up medication refills.

I would like to express my utmost appreciation for the exceptional services provided by Ark Pet Hospital. The entire staff demonstrated remarkable compassion and meticulous attention to the needs of my beloved pet.

I'm a new bird owner and recently had an emergency (I thought)...Doc got me in ASAP and fixed my baby. He was awesome in explaining what happened, how to care for it if happened again and gave great advice for him plucking his feathers... So happy I found The Ark as they are right now the street!!! The entire team is wonderful!!! VR Lisa

We ADORE Dr. H and the entire team at The Ark Pet Hospital. From regular checkups to one-off situations, I am able to get my pets the care they need quickly and efficiently. My dog loves the techs and Dr. H and gets very excited when we go to the vet office. My cat is less thrilled, but I really appreciate the time and patience they all use to make sure my cat was not stressed out even more. We love this place and highly recommend!
